label: Gang-Controlled Capital
source: UN BINUH / OHCHR Mar 2026 (90%); PM Fils-Aimé May 1, 2026 (75%)
contestNote: PM Fils-Aimé claimed 75% on May 1, 2026 (CNN/Amanpour) — the first government claim of territorial rollback since 2021. UN BINUH independent estimate remains ~90% as of March 2026. Discrepancy may reflect different methodologies or political framing of early GSF joint-operation gains.
deltaNote: Up from ~60% in 2021; 26 gangs active in capital area. PM claims early GSF joint operations have pushed gangs back to ~75% as of May 2026 — UN verification pending.

label: Internally Displaced Persons
source: IOM / DTM ETT 92 (May 2–7); UN News May 20, 2026 (+30,000 from latest Cité Soleil wave); OCHA Crisis in Numbers May 7, 2026
deltaNote: IOM ETT-92 (May 2–7) base: 1.47M+. UN News (May 20) confirmed 30,000 additional displaced from the May 10+ Cité Soleil/Cul-de-Sac violence wave, pushing total to ~1.5M. OCHA (May 7) confirms 200,000 in Port-au-Prince displacement sites alone. Shalom Church (Delmas 33) sheltering 2,000+; WFP reached 8,500 newly displaced with emergency food; 9 schools serving ~12,000 students suspended meal distributions. HaitiLibre (May 18) documented 72,000 displaced in Nippes alone. Gran Grif's May 8–9 Saint-Marc attack displaced 4,419 in Artibonite. MSF Cité Soleil hospital closure (Day 15, May 24) leaves ~300,000 commune residents without emergency medical care.

label: Need Humanitarian Assistance
source: WFP / OCHA, Apr 2026; IPC May 2026 projects 5.91M in IPC Phase 3+
deltaNote: More than half the population; ~2M in Emergency (Phase 4); 600K in IPC Phase 5 (Catastrophe/famine). May–Aug lean season projected at worst levels.

label: Killed (Q1 2026: Jan–Mar, BINUH)
contestNote: Security forces responsible for 69% of Q1 casualties (incl. 69 civilians + 5 children from drone strikes); gangs directly responsible for only 27%. Annualized pace projects 6,500+ for full-year 2026, exceeding 2024's record of 5,600+.
deltaNote: Q1 2026; preceded by 5,519 killed Mar 2025–Jan 2026 (OHCHR). 292 sexual violence victims in Q1. 13-year-old executed for flying a kite in March 2026.

label: GSF Personnel Deployed
source: Haitian Times / HaitiLibre, May 14–23, 2026; UN Security Council, Apr 23, 2026
deltaNote: Chad 400+ (1,500 expected by Jun 2026) + El Salvador (~70) + Guatemala (~75) ≈ 800 advance force as of late May 2026. Full 5,500-person force (UNSCR 2793) expected fall–end 2026. Gen. Erdenebat Batsuuri (Mongolia) commanding since May 14. GSF held high-level strategic coordination meeting with Haiti's Ministry of Defense on May 23 — signals growing institutional integration. Force remains concentrated exclusively in Port-au-Prince city center; Cité Soleil, Artibonite, Centre, Sud-Est have zero GSF coverage. $59M disbursed of $200M+ pledged. MSS final 150 Kenyan officers departed Apr 28, 2026.
